MOVES Utilities is a Windows desktop application for transportation emission analyses that use the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Motor Vehicle Emission Simulator (MOVES). The Texas A&M Transportation Institute (TTI) develops it with sponsorship from the Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT).

The application does three things:

- It builds the input databases that MOVES reads.
- It starts MOVES runs for emission rates.
- It calculates hourly emissions from the emission rates and your activity data, and writes tab files with 24-hour county totals.

MOVES itself is a separate program. You install MOVES and a MariaDB server separately. MOVES Utilities does not replace MOVES and is not an EPA product.

MOVES Utilities is configured for transportation conformity analyses. The emission rate setup uses transportation conformity settings. See [Conformity settings](releases/index.qmd#conformity-settings) for details.

## Get notified of new releases

Use either method. Neither method requires you to give your email address to TTI.

**GitHub release notifications.** You need a GitHub account.

1. Go to the [moves-utilities repository]({{< var repo.url >}}).
2. Select **Watch**, then **Custom**.
3. Check **Releases** and select **Apply**.

GitHub emails you each time a new version is published.

**RSS feeds.** Add a feed to any feed reader.

- News and announcements: [news/index.xml](news/index.xml)
- Releases only: [releases.atom]({{< var repo.releases_atom >}})
